reasons: Status is correctly characterized: p0065 selects New York law (preferred) but contains no forum, venue, or arbitration language, so the dispute-forum element of the rule is genuinely missing.

The redline is additive and directionally correct: it leaves the governing-law sentence untouched and appends exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, exactly the preferred position.
The failed 'minimal edit' check is an artifact of appending a full venue sentence to a short clause; no original wording was altered, so the edit is as small as the rule permits.

Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice and prefix, cites the playbook position, and offers the fallback; the only nit is that the playbook fallback pairs Delaware/California law with those courts, so offering DE/CA courts alongside New York law is a slight mismatch but not materially harmful.
